## Battle for Wesnoth unit art

Source: https://github.com/wesnoth/wesnoth, branch 1.18, `data/core/images/` (downloaded
2026-10-09). Project: https://www.wesnoth.org/ . Files renamed after this game's unit
types; pixels unchanged. At run time the field sprites are cropped to their drawn area and
their magenta team-colour ramp is replaced by the side's colour (the upstream convention).
